results.title: Farmington’s Civic Theater fights to reclaim moviegoers after COVID
results.description: Farmington’s Civic Theater is rich with history — and rich with loyal fans. But since the pandemic, the beloved Grand River Avenue landmark hasn’t seen the crowds it once did.
